title: Abraham and Abimelech

questions.question: Where did Abraham travel to in this chapter?
What did Abraham say about Sarah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:2: Abraham said Sarah was his sister.

questions.question: Who took Sarah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:2: Abimelech king of Gerar took Sarah.

questions.question: How did God warn Abimelech?
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:3: God came to Abimelech in a dream by night.

questions.question: Was Sarah returned to Abraham?
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:14: Abimelech returned Sarah to Abraham.

questions.question: What did God call Abraham when speaking to Abimelech?
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:7: "he is a prophet, so that he will pray for you."

questions.question: What did Abimelech give Abraham as compensation?
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:14: Abimelech gave sheep, oxen, and servants to Abraham.

questions.question: Why was Abraham called to pray for Abimelech?
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:7: "he will pray for you, and you shall live."

questions.question: Did Abimelech actually touch Sarah?
options: No, God kept him from it
questions.correctAnswer: No, God kept him from it
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:6: "I kept you from sinning against me... I did not let you touch her."

questions.question: How had God afflicted Abimelech's household?
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:18: The LORD had closed all the wombs of Abimelech's house.

questions.question: Was Sarah actually Abraham's sister?
options: No, it was a complete lie
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:12: "She is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father though not my mother."

questions.question: What did Abraham fear about Gerar?
options: There was no fear of God there
questions.correctAnswer: There was no fear of God there
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:11: "I thought, There is no fear of God at all in this place."

questions.question: How much silver did Abimelech give to Sarah as a "covering of the eyes"?
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:16: Abimelech gave 1000 pieces of silver.

questions.question: What did Abimelech offer Abraham regarding land?
options: He gave him all his land
He said Abraham could dwell wherever he pleased
questions.correctAnswer: He said Abraham could dwell wherever he pleased
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:15: "my land is before you; dwell where it pleases you."

questions.question: What happened after Abraham prayed for Abimelech?
options: God healed Abimelech's house and they bore children
questions.correctAnswer: God healed Abimelech's house and they bore children
questions.explanation: Genesis 20:17: God healed Abimelech, his wife, and female servants.

key_verse_text: 'Now then, return the man's wife, for he is a prophet, so that he will pray for you, and you shall live.'
